pillar: Myth vs reality in data and analyst careers
angle: myth: you need a perfect resume to start applying
text:
Waiting for a perfect resume usually delays your career start.

Many freshers assume every line must look flawless before submitting applications.

1) List the core projects you built using Google Sheets or SQL.
2) Focus on the business questions your analysis helped answer.
3) Keep the formatting clean and readable without extra clutter.

Clear logic and practical business thinking matter far more than polished layout templates.

Which skill on your resume needs a clearer business focus today?
